description: The profile lock protocol of spec 8.4. Every implementation that shares a profile must follow it.

ownerFields.startedAt: string: ISO 8601 UTC time the lock was acquired
ownerFields.token: string: 32 lowercase hex characters, random per acquisition

acquire: mkdir {lockDir} (mode 0700); the holder then writes {ownerFile} atomically (temp file in the lock directory, fsync, rename; mode 0600)
staleReference: mtime of ownerFile; when ownerFile is missing, mtime of the lock directory
selfFencing: a holder counts its lock as held only while its last successful touch is less than freshMs old (wall clock) and ownerFile still holds its token; otherwise every commit point (keychain or file write, OAuth refresh request) is refused with LOCK_LOST and nothing is stored
reclaimMutex: a waiter that finds the lock stale first takes the reclaim mutex with mkdir {reclaimDir}; without it, it just waits. A reclaim mutex whose directory mtime is older than staleMs is removed with a plain rmdir
staleRemoval: under the reclaim mutex: observe again, rename the lock directory to the unique sibling {lockDir}.stale-{pid}-{12 hex}, check that the moved directory is the one observed stale (same directory, same owner, still stale), then delete it; otherwise put it back if the lock path is free, else leave it in place. Siblings {lockDir}.(stale|released|failed)-{pid}-{12 hex} older than staleMs are swept
onTimeout: never run the guarded operation (never refresh, never sign); the last attempt is made at the deadline
release: only when ownerFile still holds this holder's token: rename away, check the token again, delete
